title: Sync scenario
description: A machine-readable worked example: a complete server log and the state every replica must reach. Consumed by tools/model.py and by the convergence tests of T006/T107/server. SYNC.md section 13.

covers.description: Spec conflict cases and ticket items this scenario demonstrates.

narrative.description: Human explanation, one step per line.

devices.description: Label -> device id. 'S' is the server.

log.description: The server's change log for this scenario in seq order, server-emitted ops included. Applying it in order to an empty replica (built-in seeds only) must give `expected`.

rejected.description: Ops a device pushed that the server must reject (never in the log), with the expected error code.

received_at.description: Server receive time used for the clock checks (SYNC.md 3.4). Default: wall(hlc) of the last log op.

after_seq.description: The op is checked against the server state after the log up to and including this seq (0 = only the built-ins). Default: the whole log. Needed when a later log op creates the row whose absence made the op unknown_reference, e.g. a re-minted creation (SYNC.md 10.4). Added by C-8.

remint.description: The Re-mint action of SYNC.md 10.4 that turned clock-rejected reviews into log ops. tools/validate.py recomputes the new reviewed_at values from these inputs.

offset_ms.description: sync_state.remint_offset: server_time - pt of the first response that refused one of the device's ops with a clock code.

now.description: The device's (correct) pt when it re-minted.

from.description: op_ids of the refused review.logged ops (in `rejected`), in original hlc order, undone ones excluded.

to.description: op_ids of the re-minted ops (in `log`), same order and length as `from`.

creations_from.description: op_ids (in `rejected`) of the list E of SYNC.md 10.4 step 1 (creations in the window, the ops that write a window row, the window-derived ops), in step-1 order. When present, tools/validate.py recomputes the whole selection from `rejected` and requires E, R (= `from` plus undone reviews) and `discarded` to match. Added by C-8.

creations_to.description: op_ids (in `log`) of the ops step 6a mints for `creations_from`, in mint order: one per E op, two for a re-keyed deck.item_removed (n:<owner> then the original e:<seq>); same op_type, and the step-6a payload (the original one; a window-derived e:<seq> deck item re-keyed n:<owner note id> where SYNC.md 10.4 step 6a says so); wall(hlc) = mint_at of the item's shifted time t' (step 5, one batch with the reviews of `from`). Required with `creations_from`.

discarded.description: op_ids (in `rejected`) that Re-mint deletes without minting them again (lists C, D and U of SYNC.md 10.4 step 1, minus E and R), in original hlc order. Required with `creations_from`.

order_free.description: true: ANY interleaving of the per-device op streams (each device's ops kept in log order; an op applied only once every row it references exists) must reach the same state under the convergence projection (SYNC.md section 11). false: only log order and real device orders are guaranteed.

expected.description: State after the whole log, in device representation (instants as epoch ms, arrays as JSON arrays).

rows.description: table -> list of partial rows. Each must match exactly one row: the row whose primary-key columns equal the given ones; every other listed column must be equal.

absent.description: table -> list of primary keys (objects) that must NOT exist.

replay_sets.description: card id -> review_log ids of its replay set, in replay order.
